scope: Take the three exact-profile AC1027 MATERIAL records parsed from the existing Cover.dwg source and emit each through an isolated selected-object DWG graph, then verify it with a fresh libdxfrw reader.

source.producer: Not independently certified by this receipt

output.mode: Three isolated generated AC1027 DWG files in the system temporary directory; each contains the selected source MATERIAL in a named dictionary owned by NOD.
output.readback: Fresh libdxfrw reader checks dictionary key/name, record handle, owner/reactor roles, complete semantic fields, exact retained 516-bit body, and all detached strings.
output.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture committed; temporary outputs are removed by test cleanup.

implementation.change: Added a physical-source selector that reads the three MATERIAL callbacks and individually feeds each parsed record to the selected DWG replay/readback route. Replay graph construction and readback now use the selected material's own dictionary key. The shared physical audit identifies dictionary entries by key instead of depending on entry order.

physicalSourceSelector.result: PASS for ByBlock, ByLayer and Global

limitations: This is source-fed selected-record serialization into isolated generated graphs, not a writeback of the original Cover.dwg or whole-source conversion.
Readback uses the same libdxfrw implementation; no independent producer/native reader acceptance is established.
Other AC1027 MATERIAL profiles, AC1021/AC1024 retained modern bodies, general MATERIAL semantics, and broad graph closure remain unqualified and refused.
